_meta.cashDefinition: cash = cashPop + cashBonus for that round, with no income towers, no Monkey Knowledge, no Double Cash. Pop cash is the same on every difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard/Impoppable/CHIMPS); only Half Cash halves it (and the bonus).
_meta.cashBonusFormula: 100 + round (paid at the end of each round)
_meta.popCashMultiplierNote: 101-120 = 8% and 121-140 = 5% per the v53.0 patch notes ("5% -> 8%", "2% -> 5%"; 'final freeplay income cut pushed back 20 rounds') and the bloonswiki Freeplay page (re-checked 2026-11-05). The bloonswiki Rounds/ABR tables still compute 101-140 at 5%/4%; their figures are kept as cashPopWikiTable for rounds 101-140. Rounds 1-100 cash columns follow the bloonswiki Rounds (BTD6) table exactly.

cumulativeFields.cumCash: Sum of cash for rounds 1..r (Easy/Medium/Primary/Military/Reverse start at R1). Excludes starting cash.
cumulativeFields.cumCashFromR3: Sum for rounds 3..r: Hard Standard, Magic Monkeys Only, Double HP MOABs, Half Cash (halve it), ABR (use the abr array).
cumulativeFields.cumCashFromR6: Sum for rounds 6..r: Impoppable and CHIMPS.

_meta.startingCashByMode: Cash in hand after finishing round r = startingCash + cumulative field for that mode. Starting cash $650 for every mode except Deflation ($20,000 at R31, and no income at all, so cumulative cash does not apply) and Half Cash ($325, and halve every cumulative figure). More Cash MK adds $200 except in CHIMPS. Examples (calc): Medium after R40 = 650 + 16,856 = $17,506; Hard after R80 = 650 + 97,345.6 = $97,995.6; CHIMPS after R99 (what you have going into R100) = 650 + cumCashFromR6[99] = $650 + 176,724.8 = $177,374.8.
_meta.freeplayModifiers: From R81: Super Ceramics (60 HP, 1 child per layer), MOAB-class HP ramp (+2%/round 81-100, +5% 101-124, +15% 125-150) and speed ramp. These are already included in rbe for rounds 81-140.
_meta.easyRound40: On Easy the R40 MOAB has 2/3 HP (133), so its RBE is 549 not 616.
_meta.xpFormula: 20r+20 (r<=20); 40(r-20)+420 (21-50); 90(r-50)+1620 (51+). Base, before map multiplier (x1/1.1/1.2/1.3) or Monkey Education. Freeplay rounds pay 30% (to R100) / 10% (R101+).
_meta.danger: 0-3 heuristic: 3 = community-listed killer/milestone rounds, 2 = notable property or MOAB-class check, 1 = moderate, 0 = trivial. Rounds 81-140 not hand-rated default to 2, or 3 if RBE >= 400k, a BAD, or 20+ Fortified DDTs. Opinion, not game data.
_meta.validation: Every composition was checked against its RBE and pop cash with an independent bloon model (HP, children, fortified, R81+ super ceramics and MOAB ramp): all 140 Standard and 140 ABR rounds reproduce the wiki RBE and pop cash exactly.
_meta.abrCumulative: In the abr array use cumCashFromR3 (ABR starts at R3); cumCash (from R1) only applies to custom challenges.
_meta.abrNote: ABR is played on Hard from R3; normal win at R80, R81-140 are optional freeplay. Impoppable and CHIMPS use the STANDARD rounds, not ABR. ABR R1-2 exist only in custom challenges.
_meta.verification2: 2026-11-05 adversarial check (VERIFY-2-economy.md): cash = cashPop + cashBonus, cashBonus = 100 + r, cumCash / cumCashFromR3 / cumCashFromR6 and xp recomputed programmatically for all 140 standard + 140 ABR rounds: 0 mismatches. 20 standard rounds (1,10,27,38,40,45,49,50,51,60,63,65,76,78,79,85,90,95,98,100) spot-checked against the live bloonswiki round table for RBE and pop cash: 20/20 match. XP formula confirmed by sarahs-btd6-site; freeplay XP 30% (to R100) / 10% (R101+) confirmed by bloonswiki Freeplay. Mode totals: modes.json totalCashNoIncome = startCash + (sum of cash start..end minus the final round's bonus) x cashMult, matching ch.08.
